leah_sales: Hey team — launching a short Orion pilot next week. Need help provisioning billing project + POC creds. Requirements: Hosted API keys + optional Dedicated pool during demo window, VPC peering for Private option, spend cap of $5,000, invoice billing/PO, and scoped service account for data isolation. Who can create the billing project and attach quota/spendshield?

toma_eng: I can handle the POC API keys + quota mapping. Need the customer's org id and preferred region. Also: ephemeral keys or an SA for CI?

leah_sales: They prefer ephemeral keys for dev, but want an SA for CICD. Org id is ORION-98765, region: us-west-2. Demo window 2026-04-01 → 2026-04-14.

bryan_infra: For VPC/private peering we need their VPC CIDR and whether they want peering or private link. Dedicated pool needs capacity estimate (GPU type + count) and expected concurrency.

leah_sales: They'll run ~20 rps peak, ~40M tokens/day. Requesting 2x A10-equivalent for the dedicated demo. VPC CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16, prefer peering.

ellen_sec: Heads-up: security needs the completed questionnaire, IP allowlist, and KMS key policy. Also confirm logs residency — we need that before granting SA access.

leah_sales: I'll push the questionnaire today. Logs must remain in US data centers.

toma_eng: Plan: I will create a billing project, enable spendshield, and provision ephemeral keys. Ephemeral flow (console): `POST /v1/keys?scope=ephemeral`. SA naming we plan: `svc-orion-poc@redwood-prod`. Finance sign-off required for invoiced pilots > $3k.

finance_bot: @bryan_infra Finance: approval required for invoiced pilots over $3k. Submit PO or request pre-approval here: https://redwood.internal/finance/pilot-invoice (include org id ORION-98765).

bryan_infra: Filing capacity ticket for dedicated pool (2x A10) for 2026-03-31 → 2026-04-15. @toma_eng can you set quota limits and attach the $5k spend cap label?

toma_eng: Will set quotas: calls/min = 600, tokens/day = 50,000,000. Adding spend cap tag `pilot_orion_5k` and creating ephemeral keys + least-privilege SA.

ellen_sec: After keys are live I'll run an access review and validate KMS policy. Customer prefers customer-managed KMS; we'll need the key ARN.

leah_sales: They'll provide KMS details by EOD. Please ping me when billing project, quotas, and keys are ready so I can share with Orion. Thanks! :thumbsup:
